name: Flying Dresses Egypt
description: Flying-dress photoshoots in Egypt: a rooftop above the Pyramids of Giza, the sand dunes outside Cairo, and the lakes and white dunes of Fayoum. Twelve dresses, traditional Egyptian attire for men, door-to-door transport and 100+ colour-graded photographs. Dress rental without a photoshoot is available separately.
heroSupport: A flowing dress above Giza an hour before the gates open, or out in the dunes with nobody else in the frame. You leave with more than a hundred colour-graded photographs, not a handful.

packageIncludes.title: Door-to-door transportation
packageIncludes.detail: Collected from your hotel or address and brought back afterwards. Free within our Giza service area; from further out in Cairo, including New Cairo, there may be a transport charge, which we confirm with you before you book.

packageIncludes.title: 100+ colour-graded photographs
packageIncludes.detail: Not a handful of selects. More than a hundred edited frames from one session.

packageIncludes.title: One flying dress, yours for the session
packageIncludes.detail: Rented from the collection for the shoot, in the colour you choose. Included in the price. Choosing one does not change what you pay.

packageIncludes.title: A stylist for the dress
packageIncludes.detail: One person whose whole job is the garment: dressing and fitting you, then holding the train, throwing it, and keeping it out of the sand between frames.

packageIncludes.title: A directed session
packageIncludes.detail: Directed throughout. You do not need to know how to pose. That is the photographer's job and the dress does the rest.

packageIncludes.title: A Reel from the session
packageIncludes.detail: A short vertical edit is included with every experience. Longer or more involved video is a separate, paid piece of work.

packageIncludes.title: Your unedited images, if you want them
packageIncludes.detail: Ask and we will send the originals as well, at no charge. They come as compressed JPGs rather than camera RAW files.

packageIncludes.title: Delivered in 6 to 10 days
packageIncludes.detail: Your edited gallery, within six to ten days of the shoot.

paymentNote: No payment is taken on this website. Nothing on these pages charges a card, and we will never ask you to type card details into a form here.

paymentMethods.label: Visa and MasterCard
paymentMethods.detail: On the day of the shoot, on request.

cancellationSummary: Deposits are non-refundable, and can usually be moved to another date or held as credit rather than lost. The exact notice periods and charges are confirmed in writing when we hold your date.
